datadeletion.confirmDesc:
This will permanently delete all data the bot has stored about you across all servers, including:
- Warnings, strikes, and moderator notes
- XP, level, and message counts
- Reminders, polls, giveaways, and tags you created
- Tickets you opened or participated in

**This action is permanent and cannot be undone.**
Discord message logs in channels are not affected (those belong to Discord, not this bot).
